name: essence Lash Princess False Lash Effect Mascara

pin.headline: Drugstore mascara, false-lash look
pin.sub: Volume + length · Cone brush · Vegan & cruelty-free

scenes.line: More than four hundred thousand shoppers rated this drugstore mascara, and it keeps getting compared to tubes that cost way more.
Meet the essence Lash Princess False Lash Effect Mascara. One or two coats for longer, fuller, lifted lashes.
The cone brush loads your outer lashes, and the tip reaches inner corners. Vegan, cruelty-free and fragrance-free.

scenes.title: PRO TIP
scenes.note: Need it to survive tears or humidity? Get the waterproof version.
scenes.line: Pro tip: tap off the extra on the tube rim, wiggle up from the root, and stop at two thin coats to skip clumps.
It's pick number thirty-two. Find the link on our channel, under Video Picks.
